name: Grand Hyatt Deer Valley
insider_take: This alpine sanctuary sits at the base of Utah's most exclusive ski resort, where champagne powder meets five-star luxury in Park City's crown jewel destination.
whats_special: The Grand Hyatt Deer Valley is the only ski-in/ski-out hotel at Deer Valley Resort, renowned for limiting daily skier numbers to ensure pristine conditions. The resort famously prohibits snowboarding, maintaining perfectly groomed runs that attract celebrities and skiing purists alike. The hotel's location offers direct access to slopes that hosted events during the 2002 Winter Olympics.
pro_tip: Book your spa treatment for après-ski hours – the hotel's Marilyn Monroe Spa uses locally-sourced botanicals and offers mountain views that are especially stunning during golden hour.
dont_miss: The resort's legendary ski valets who will carry your equipment and help with boots – a signature Deer Valley service. Also explore historic Main Street in Park City, just minutes away, where the Sundance Film Festival transforms the town each January into Hollywood's winter playground.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location at prestigious Deer Valley Resort
Luxurious mountain resort with exceptional spa and wellness facilities
Exclusive Hyatt Privé benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
Year-round outdoor activities and stunning mountain scenery
cons: Premium pricing reflecting luxury mountain resort positioning
Seasonal accessibility with peak demand during ski season
